title: Midwinter
description: This project adds multiple items related to the holiday season, including new decoration blocks like decorative lights, new food items like candy canes, and new plants like poinsettias
body:
This is a mod centred around the holiday season and celebrating it. It adds many new blocks and items related to the season, such as:

**Food**

Candy Canes

Mince Pies

**Decorations**

Fairy Lights

Wreaths

Stockings

**Plants**

Poinsettia

Red Amaryllis

I’m open to suggestions or requests — feel free to reach out if you have a mod idea.

If you notice any bugs or have any suggestions please contact me at italianchef123@hotmail.com or on discord at italianchef123
